I farm 18 mu here in Quzhou. I only went through primary school, so I do what my father taught me and what I see my neighbors doing. I will not change much from last year — last year was alright, the cotton gave me almost 280 jin per mu.

Most of my land goes to cotton — that is my main crop and what pays for the year. I will put 12 mu in cotton. The other 6 mu I keep for winter wheat and then summer corn right after, for our own flour and for pig feed. With 6 mouths at home we need some grain of our own.

For cotton I plough deep in spring — cotton likes loose soil, the roots go deep. I put down 2 bags of compound 15-15-15 per mu when I plough, then when the bolls start forming I top-dress with about half a bag of urea per mu. That comes to roughly 18 jin of nitrogen. Cotton is the one crop where I do not save on spray — bollworm and aphids will eat everything if you are lazy. I spray 7 times, that is what Old Zhang next to me does and his cotton is always clean. I water from my well 2 times if the rain is short. I use the Bt hybrid seed, everyone uses it now, the old kind cannot stand the pests.

For wheat I rotary till the stubble and drill the improved seed in October. One bag of compound when sowing, then urea at green-up in spring — about 16 jin nitrogen total. I water 3 times: before winter, at green-up, and at grain fill. Spray 2 times for aphids and rust. I expect 450 jin per mu like last year.

After wheat, corn goes straight in, no ploughing — I just push the seed into the stubble. Hybrid seed, one bag of compound at sowing, urea at knee-high. Corn here gets enough rain in summer, I only water 1 time if July is dry. 2 sprays for borer. I look for 500 jin per mu.

I do not want to spend too much on fertilizer, but I would rather use a bit extra than see my cotton short — one bad cotton year and I lose real money.
